text: Biomedical engineering is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates engineering, biology, medicine and computer science, aiming to solve practical problems in medical diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation and health monitoring through engineering and technical means. The course centers on "Medical demand-driven Engineering Innovation", aiming to cultivate students' abilities in biological system modeling, medical equipment research and development, and medical data analysis. It enables students to engage in technology development, clinical application, or academic research in fields such as medical device research and development, hospital technical departments, biopharmaceuticals, and scientific research institutions, and to become compound talents with interdisciplinary thinking.
